title: Supreme Court: Alabama Assn. of Realtors v. Department of Health and Human Servs.
summary: The District Court’s judgment—which vacated as unlawful the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention’s imposition of a nationwide moratorium on evictions of any tenants who live in a county that is experiencing substantial or high levels of COVID–19 transmission and who make certain declarations of financial need, 86 Fed. Reg. 43244—is enforceable and the stay of that judgment is vacated. (No. 21A23, opinion by the Court (per curiam); 594 U.S. 758).
